messages.text: The view raced the plot; retrying.

I plotted monthly revenue from `data/sales.csv` as a bar chart and saved it to `design notes/monthly revenue.png`. It's shown above, and I also opened it on your Mac.

Revenue climbs from about 41k in January to about 72k in December, with small dips in February, June and October.
